faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WDRA Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the WDRA Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) post is 06 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Law from a Government recognised University and have at least three years of experience in dealing with legal matters to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the WDRA Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) post is 56 years. There is no mention of minimum age criteria in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) position in the Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority (WDRA) through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 per month, as per Level-07 of the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the WDRA Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the WDRA Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application through the proper channel, vigilance clearance, and a review of the CR Dossier. These steps ensure the selection of suitable candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the WDRA Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the WDRA Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of the Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority (WDRA)?
faq.answer: The official website of the Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority is www.wdra.gov.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and to download the application form.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Deputation job type. Candidates will be appointed on a deputation basis to the Assistant (Enforcement and Legal) post.
